recipes.label: Consult with a companion?
recipes.startdescription: My Friend, My Comrade in strife. I can talk with them if I have some time, or have them do something they're good at.

recipes.label: Consult with a companion?
recipes.startdescription: Someone who claims to be my 'Friend'. I can talk with them if I have some time, or have them do something they're good at. Some things I won't make them do.

recipes.label: Unfettered
recipes.startdescription: The rules of war are not my rules. [Some things have changed.]

recipes.label: Consult with a Future Enemy
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>They're just going to turn on me eventually.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Consult with Vanja?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Vanja by his usual small spot in our camp.

'Y-Yes mister ? Can I help s-somehow... ?'

recipes.label: Consult with a child?
recipes.startdescription: Vanja took notice of my hopelessness, he immediately approaches me when I enter our camp and with great difficulty offers me his teddy bear. 'M-Mom and Dad gave me Mishka to f-feel better... M-Maybe it will make you feel better t-too...'

recipes.label: <color=red>Dead Weight<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
It takes me time to find Vanja, the boy was hiding from me again. When I find him he's shaking at my presence.

'P-Please... I-I am scared...'

recipes.label: Consult with Eva?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Eva sitting alone once more. The woman at first ignores me and keeps staring with her empty expression before she eventually looks up at me.

'What do you want from me this time ?'

recipes.label: Consult with a grieving mother?
recipes.startdescription:
Finding Eva stopped being a difficulty ever since I secluded myself from others. This time she speaks nearly immediately when I arrive.

'I see you finally undersand. Good.'

recipes.label: <color=red>Loathsome Thing<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
Just like others, Eva started avoiding me whenever possible. When I finally corner her, she can't look me in the eyes.

'Just tell me what to do and leave.'

recipes.label: Consult with Tibor?
recipes.startdescription:
I find our doctor slowly changing his bandages again. The sight of his burns under them still unsettles me.

'I can still help others somewhat, don't worry about it.'

recipes.label: Consult with a burnt doctor?
recipes.startdescription:
Whatever repulsion I had at the sight of Tibor's burns is long gone.

'Sorry... But even I can't help with what you are going throught right now.'

recipes.label: <color=red>Burnt Husk<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
When I find Tibor changing his bandages, he immediately drops his action and speaks to me with his burns laid bare. He knows it's best not to keep me waiting.

'You are no better than the germans. And you don't care, do you ?'

recipes.label: Consult with Walther?
recipes.startdescription:
I find old priest sitting by the campfire. He's reading from the bible again, one of the only posessions he still has.

'Come closer, our situation is dire but all wars will eventually end.'

recipes.label: Consult with a priest?
recipes.startdescription:
When I pass the campfire, Walther is trying to get to me again. It's not the first time, and I know it won't be the last.

'I know it's hard for you to see it, but there's still hope out there. Just stay with me for a while to show it.'

recipes.label: <color=red>Useless Clergyman<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
I pass the campfire and can see Walther sitting by it. He no longer has his Bible, I ordered him to burn his useless book. We exchange spiteful glances at each other before he speaks.

'You are beyond saving.'

recipes.label: Consult with Yuri?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Yuri 'motivating' our soldiers as he usually does.

'If you won't serve in combat, you will serve on the fi-!'

I interrupt him midway to talk with him.

'Apologies comrade, those two were slacking off. I assume my assistance is needed elsewhere?'

recipes.label: Consult with Konstantin?
recipes.startdescription:
When I enter the doctor's tent, my nostrils are immiediatelly attacked by the stench of gore that always accompanies his work. The doctor stares at me from the other end of the tent as he notices me.

'If my experience is needed again, make it quick. I have many amputations to deal with today.'

recipes.label: Consult with Iosef?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Iosef where I always find him, still tucked into his makeshift bed and clutching to his cigaretes. He reluctantly stands up when I enter.

'Please... Don't tell me I am being sent out again...'

recipes.label: Consult with Nikolai?
recipes.startdescription:
Nikolai was once again busy maintaining our machinery in his spare time when I find him. He doesn't interrupt his work and barely looks at me as I talk to him.

'Da?'

recipes.label: Consult with Fiorenza?
recipes.startdescription: I am forced to go through a few of Fiorenza's admirers while attempting to speak with her. Once she's free from them, she lets out a sigh of relief. 'Grazie... I appreciate everybody being so nice towards to me, but a break would be nice... Anyhow, is there anything I can help with?'

recipes.label: Consult with Lorenzo?
recipes.startdescription: Althought I didn't go to him for a meal, I am forced to wait in line just like everybody who wishes to taste Lorenzo's dishes. There's no shortage of grumbles as I take our cook away from the kitchen to talk. 'Just make it quick friend, our comrades won't make it for long without their spezzatino.'

recipes.label: Consult with Padre?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Padre praying at our makeshift chapel. I respectully give our exorcist time to finish his prayers before starting to talk with him.

'I wish times were better, but if you say it's time to act then I shall oblige.'

recipes.label: Consult with Daria?
recipes.startdescription:
Daria is resting calmly from a high place as she always does. She notices me in spite of me approaching in complete silence and smiles as she looks down on me.

'I knew you would be back... Who am I killing today ?'

recipes.label: Talk with a Companion
recipes.startdescription: I have some time. I can talk with my companion for a little while. [This will give you a useful memory]
recipes.description: An enjoyable diversion. Back to striving.

recipes.label: Canniballize the Fallen: Eva
recipes.startdescription:
Eva has some experience eating corpses. She can get more out of it than others could, and faster.

[This will produce more Provisions than the usual interaction, but may cause Allies without the stomach for atrocity to abandon you.]
recipes.description: Just a little more to eat, now.

recipes.label: Cannibalise the Fallen?
recipes.startdescription: I'm not about to stoop that low. They don't deserve this.

recipes.label: Devour a Slain Creature: Eva
recipes.startdescription:
Eva has some experience eating corpses. She can get more out of it than others could, and faster.

[This will produce more Provisions than the usual interaction.]
recipes.description: Just a little more to eat, now.

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Vanja
recipes.startdescription: Someone small and quiet can probe the enemy, giving us useful intel. [This can fail, wounding Vanja. The chances of this working is higher the more moth aspect Vanja has.]

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Vanja. Success!
recipes.description: Vanja comes back, with information on our enemy.

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Vanja. Failure!
recipes.description: Vanja comes back, crying and wounded.

recipes.label: Heal Wounded: Tibor
recipes.startdescription: The good doctor still has his healing techniques. It'll do, for this one.
recipes.description: And done. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Heal Me: Tibor
recipes.startdescription: The good doctor still has his healing techniques. It'll do, for me.
recipes.description: I grimace as Tibor finishes stiching my wound. Back towards an ending.

recipes.label: Counselling: Walther
recipes.startdescription: What doubts do I have, what traumas do I want to get off my chest? Walther may be able to help me with them.
recipes.description:
Walther nods.

'Light persists. The dawn will arrive, eventually.'

recipes.label: Counselling?
recipes.startdescription: Hopeless, its all so hopeless. Walther can't help me.

recipes.label: <color=red>Clarity<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>I deserve this.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Scour Impurity: Walter
recipes.startdescription: Walther still remembers his time as a solar clergyman. The sun can extirpate this obstacle from my path. Hopefully. [This can fail and wound Walther. The more lantern Walther has the higher chance this succeeds.]

recipes.label: Scour Impurity: Walter. Success!
recipes.description: Dawn breaks, and Walther is there. He raises his hands towards the sky. A force moves through the air. There is a light. I find my path clearer.

recipes.label: Scour Impurity: Walter. Failure!
recipes.description: Dawn breaks, and so does Walther, with a few pieces missing.

recipes.label: Scavenge Warzone: Daria
recipes.startdescription: I talk to daria about the current warzone. 'I can find some useful things here, capitan. [This can fail, wounding Daria. Sometimes this produces nothing. The more moth aspect Daria has the higher chance this will succeed.]

recipes.label: Scavenge Warzone: Daria. Success!
recipes.description: 'Presto!'

recipes.label: Daria Sends her Regards!
recipes.startdescription: While out scavenging, Daria used her new favorite toy to quickly dispose one of our enemies. Handy.

recipes.label: Scavenge Warzone: Daria. Failure!
recipes.description: Daria returns, battered. 'Fucking fascisti'.

recipes.label: Search the dead for anything useful: Daria
recipes.startdescription: Check their packs and pockets; their stiff and clutching hands.
recipes.description: Here's what we have to show.

recipes.label: Heal Wounded: Lorenzo
recipes.startdescription:
Lorenzo nods.

'I'll get them back in the fight.'
recipes.description: <i>Spezzatino<.i> and some rest. Back to liberation.

recipes.label: Heal Me: Lorenzo
recipes.startdescription: 'Don't worry, my friend. Some spezzatino, stiches, and bandages will do you good.
recipes.description: I wince as Lorenzo finishes patching me up. at least the spezzatino was good.

recipes.label: Cook a monstrous corpse: Lorenzo
recipes.startdescription: Lorenzo takes a moment to examine the cadaver. 'This will add flavor to the spezzatino.
recipes.description: 'Just don't ask where the meat came from.'

recipes.label: Rally a Friend: Fiorenza
recipes.startdescription:
Fiorenza smiles.

'I can motivate them!'
recipes.description: 'Keep fighting friends, we can win this!'

recipes.label: Counselling: Padre
recipes.startdescription: What doubts do I have, what traumas do I want to get off my chest? Padre may be able to help me with them.
recipes.description: Padre nods, solemnly. 'Remember why you fight. Remember the fallen. Keep your faith, no matter how many times you may fall.'

recipes.label: Exorcise Undead: Padre
recipes.startdescription: Padre has some experience putting the dead to rest. I can have him attempt to exorcise these living dead, and put them at peace once more. [This can fail, wounding Padre. The more winter Padre has the higher chance this will succeed.]

recipes.label: Exorcise Undead: Padre. Success!
recipes.description: 'L'eterno riposo dona loro, o Signore, e splenda ad essi la luce perpetua. Riposino in pace. Amen.'

recipes.label: Exorcise Undead: Padre. Success!
recipes.description:
Padre returns, saddened and wounded.

'I have failed.'

recipes.label: Exorcise Fallen Soldiers: Padre
recipes.startdescription: These soldiers are already dead. It's time they knew that. [This won't fail.]
recipes.description: 'L'eterno riposo dona loro, o Signore, e splenda ad essi la luce perpetua. Riposino in pace. Amen.'

recipes.label: Rally a Comrade: Yuri
recipes.startdescription:
Yuri nods.

'They're shirking their duty, my friend. Let me talk to them.'
recipes.description: 'For the Motherland!'

recipes.label: Rally a Comrade: Yuri
recipes.startdescription:
Yuri readies his revolver with glee in his eyes.

'They're shirking their duty, my friend. Let me talk to them.'
recipes.description: 'For the Motherland!'

recipes.label: Heal Wounded: Konstantin
recipes.startdescription:
I have to remind Konstantin that this one is not to be used for experimentation.

'A pity. Well, they'll be back up for you, comrade.'
recipes.description: My ally comes out looking a little shaken, but unscarred.

recipes.label: Heal and 'Motivate' Wounded: Konstantin
recipes.description: Something changed in Konstantin's latest patient, they fight more fiercely than before and listen to orders with no hesistation. Konstantin refuses to answer what he has done with them, citting 'Doctor-Patient Confidentiality'.

recipes.label: Repair Vehicle: Nikolai
recipes.startdescription: I gesture at the broken machinery. Nikolai nods. 'Da.'
recipes.description: Our machinery returns to functionality and Nikolai leaves in silence.

recipes.label: Heal Me: Konstantin
recipes.startdescription:
'You look a little worse for wear, comrade. Just relax, this wont take long.'

Not very reassuring words.
recipes.description: I grunt as Konstantin finishes his work. Back to duty.

recipes.label: Recycle Corpse: Nikolai
recipes.startdescription:
I gesture at the corpse. Nikolai nods.

'Da.'
recipes.description: Nikolai hands me something, and leaves in silence.

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Iosef
recipes.startdescription: 'tovarisch, I don't think this is a good idea.' [This can fail, wounding Iosef. The higher moth aspect Iosef has the higher chance this will succeed.]

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Iosef. Success!
recipes.description:
Iosef comes back, shivering but unharmed with information on our enemy.

'Please don't send me out like that again.'

recipes.label: Intel and Supplies
recipes.description: Iosef comes back, shivering but unharmed with information on our enemy and portion of their supplies. 'If I'm risking my life for it, I might aswell take something of actual value while im at it.'

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Iosef. Failure!
recipes.description: Iosef comes back, bleeding and freezing. 'I told you this was a bad idea!'

recipes.label: Search the dead for anything useful: Iosef
recipes.startdescription: Check their packs and pockets; their stiff and clutching hands.
recipes.description: Here's what we have to show.

recipes.label: Reassign a Companion
recipes.startdescription: I could cut down on the size of my contingent by assigning my companion elsewhere. Perhaps we must travel lighter. Perhaps we must run. But the connection i've made will still last.
recipes.description: I shake hands with my companion, and watch them leave. I may have need of their services again, someday.

recipes.label: Reassign a Wounded Companion
recipes.startdescription: I could cut down on the size of my contingent by assigning my companion elsewhere. They're wounded, so it's going to take some time before I can call them back if I need them.

recipes.label: Companion in Healing...
recipes.startdescription: Time does what it usually does, and passes. I hope my companion is doing well.

recipes.label: Recall a Companion?
recipes.startdescription: I have need of my companion's services once more. Without working communications, someone is going to need to be a courier.

recipes.label: Recall a Companion
recipes.startdescription: I have need of my companion's services once more. Without working communications, someone is going to need to be a courier.
recipes.description: It's good to have friends.

recipes.label: Recall a Companion
recipes.startdescription: Send word over wire and wave. I have need of my companion's services once more.
recipes.description: It's good to have friends.

recipes.label: Awaiting Companion...
recipes.startdescription: Time does what it usually does, and passes. With luck, my companion is already en route.

recipes.label: Awaiting Companion...
recipes.startdescription: Time does what it usually does, and passes. I can only hope that our messenger has gone unharried by the enemy or by the elements.

recipes.label: Arrived!
recipes.startdescription: It's good to have friends.

recipes.label: An Unshakeable Belief
recipes.startdescription: Fanaticism isn't without it's benefits...
recipes.description: Fanaticism isn't without it's benefits...

recipes.label: Ghastly Exchanges
recipes.startdescription: My follower does not mean to unnerve me when they speak. I am half-certain they do not.
recipes.description: My follower does not mean to unnerve me when they speak. I am half-certain they do not.

recipes.label: A Series of Pleasantries
recipes.startdescription: My follower is possessed of an infectious sense of optimism -
recipes.description: My follower is possessed of an infectious sense of optimism -

recipes.label: An Inspiring Idea
recipes.startdescription: My companion has came up with a new idea, a new plan...
recipes.description: My companion has came up with a new idea, a new plan...

recipes.label: Minutes and Memory
recipes.startdescription: My follower reminds me of certain moments, and certain forgotten things -
My follower reminds me of certain moments, and certain forgotten things -

recipes.label: Unexpected Insights
recipes.startdescription: My follower has found something new and unexpected...
My follower has found something new and unexpected...

recipes.label: A Sidearm for a Commissar
recipes.startdescription: Yuri has been complaining how his usual way of 'motivating' our soldiers is no longer as effective. I am sure giving his sidearm an upgrade would help remedy this issue.
recipes.description: Yuri salutes me in earnest as I gift him the revolver, his stern gaze hides deep excitment he is feeling. 'Thank you comrade, this shall ensure our soldiers are more scared of taking a step back than of the enemy in front of them.' [Yuri's cooldown from motivating an ally has been halved.]

recipes.label: An Eye for a Friend
recipes.startdescription: To say Iosef would preffer to be anywhere else but in this war would be an understandment. Still, by giving him something of real value I might convince him to put at least some effort into his actions.
recipes.description: Iosef glances at the pearl and then back at me as if he was suspecting this to be a trap. Eventually he slowly takes it and carefully packages the pearl into his backpocket before allowing himself a reluctant smile. 'Good to see I can still count on our friendship... Tovarish.' [Iosef will steal supplies from enemies when he scopes them out.]

recipes.label: A Sample for a Doctor
recipes.startdescription: Konstantin still grumbles under his nose about him not being allowed to experiment on our soldiers. Perhaps if I give him something to satiate his scientifical craving then he will focus more on healing our soldiers.
recipes.description: Konstantin looks at the sample I gave him with palpable surprise and curiosity. 'Digitium regius... I thought all samples were incinerated long ago...'. The doctor immediately left for his study in medical tent afterwards. [Healing allies with konstantin will buff them after healing.]

recipes.label: A Tool for a Craftsman
recipes.startdescription: Nikolai is well versed with arts of the forge but he is lacking tools neccesary to perform them. He might find better use for those nails than I would.
recipes.description: Nikolai takes the nails and returns to work without saying anything, but next day our contingent find one of our vechiles working as if it was rid of all its issues. Nikolai is looking at the rejuvanated vehicle away from the others and nods. [Nikolai can repair damaged vehicles now.]

recipes.label: A Gun for a Partisan
recipes.startdescription: Daria is used to taking Potshots from the Fascisti, doesn't mean she likes that in the slightest. I might give her a way to defend herself with adequate weapon.
recipes.description: Daria's eyes gleams when I hand her the rifle that once belonged to my friend. 'A gift for poor me ? Why, thank you Captain.' I am sure they would be happy to hear who recieved their former weapon. [Daria has a chance to kill enemies while scavenging warzones.]

recipes.label: A Cross for a Priest
recipes.startdescription: Being given Crucifix of St. Lucia: To Padre's sadness, his exorcisms not always succeds and lost souls continue clinging to this world. While not exatly a solar clergyman, I am sure Padre would apprieciate one of their tools.
recipes.description: Padre slowly takes the crucifix from my hands and nods solemnly. 'Thank you, thanks to you many souls will finally get to experience peace.' [Exorcisms will always succeed now.]
